item.title: Help with deploying an R Markdown HTML document and automatically sending it to Slack at scheduled times.
item.description: I built an R Markdown HTML document, and the idea is to automate the run, generate the HTML output, and host the link so it can be shared in a Slack channel. Has anyone done something similar? How did you approach it? Thank you so much!
